environment.description: Consumer deployed as an ECS Fargate task in an isolated private subnet (no NAT gateway, no IGW). The MSK cluster is accessed exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.kafka-xyz interface endpoint with a VPC endpoint policy that restricts kafka:CreateTopic and kafka:Produce actions to only the IAM role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/IngestPipelineProducer. The consumer's task role has kafka:Consume only. The VPC endpoint's security group (sg-0abc123) allows inbound TCP/9098 only from the CIDR 10.40.0.0/24 (the producer subnet). Additionally, the Fargate task uses a read-only root filesystem with an ephemeral tmpfs mounted at /opt/processor/workspace (size limited to 512MB), and the task definition specifies a non-root user (uid 10001) with a Linux capability drop of ALL capabilities. The MSK cluster has ACLs enforcing that only the IngestPipelineProducer principal can write to the 'file-uploads' topic.

config.network: isolated private subnet, no NAT, no IGW, no public route
config.msk_acls: WRITE on topic 'file-uploads' restricted to IngestPipelineProducer CN
config.fargate_task: readonlyRootFilesystem=true, tmpfs at /opt/processor/workspace (512MB), user=10001, linuxCapabilities drop ALL
